column1: # Benchmarks gated by tooling/scripts/benchmark_ratchet_check.sh.
# module_dir
# Selection rule: a gated benchmark must be DETERMINISTIC in allocs/op and
# B/op. Benchmarks that fan work across goroutines (b.RunParallel, bus publish
# with live subscribers) allocate a scheduler-dependent number of times per
# iteration and would flake the gate, so they stay out and are covered by the
# benchmark ledger instead. Benchmarks over real sockets, disks, or databases
# belong to the service-backed lane, not here.
# Add a row, then record ceilings:
#   HUMAN_SUPERVISED_CHECK_UPDATE=1 UPDATE=1 tooling/scripts/benchmark_ratchet_check.sh . --write
# The null lane (framework floor) and the single-goroutine app-path lanes.
# BenchmarkAppLane_Worker_* is deliberately excluded: it hands work to a pool,
# so its allocs/op and B/op move with goroutine scheduling. Measured drift of
# ~40 B/op between consecutive runs on identical hardware confirmed it cannot
# be gated. Worker-pool cost is tracked in the benchmark ledger instead.
